title: Multiplication Table
statementMd:
Print the multiplication table of **n** from 1 to 10, one line each, in the form `n x i = product`.

**Input**
One integer `n` (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000).

**Output**
Ten lines: `n x 1 = …` up to `n x 10 = …`.
hints: A for loop from i = 1 to 10 prints one line per step.
Build each line as n + " x " + i + " = " + (n * i) — note the brackets around the product.
